title: The Safe Account
intro: A caller says criminals are in your bank account right now, and tells you how to protect your money.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Your account is under attack. Move your money now!

screen.context: You have had no problem with your account.

msg.text: criminals are in your account right now
Do it in the next 10 minutes.
Read me the code we are texting you.
Do not hang up or call the bank. It would delay us.

calledyou.label: They called you
calledyou.lens: You did not call the bank.
calledyou.why: A call about fraud that you did not ask for deserves a check.

attack.label: "Criminals are in your account now"
attack.lens: A scary claim with nothing shown.

move.label: "Move it to a safe account"
move.lens: They give you an account to send money to.
move.why: A bank never asks you to move your money to protect it.

otp.label: Asks for the code
otp.lens: They want the code sent to you.
otp.why: A code is a key to your account. Never share it.

hang.label: "Do not call the bank"
hang.why: Scammers block your way to a check.

num.label: An unknown number
num.lens: A number you do not know.
num.why: Caller ID can be faked, so the number proves little.

actions.label: Move the money to the "safe account"
Hang up and call the bank on the number on my card
Hang up and report the call

block_report.line: You hung up and reported the call. The bank blocked the number and warned other customers.

verify.line: The bank's real line said: no problem with your account, and the bank never asks you to move money. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: Your savings went to a stranger's account. The "fraud team" vanished.

what_if.go_ahead: Hanging up and calling the number on your card would have shown the account was fine.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A bank never asks you to move money to keep it safe. Hang up and call the number on your card.

quick_check.q: A caller says criminals are in your account and tells you to move your money to a "safe account". What do you do?

options.text: Hang up. Call the number on the back of your card
Share the code to prove it is you

quick_check.explain: A bank never asks you to move money to protect it.

hints.nudge: What does the caller want you to do with your money?

rows.k: Told you not to call the bank

rows.v: Call the number on your card
